title: Token fragment resolver and chat-template compatibility sweep for onboarding
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: When onboarding new model bundles we see intermittent mismatches between the tokenizer's subtoken boundaries and the chat template role delimiters for languages that use combining marks, ZWJ/ZWSP, or non-space tokenization (e.g., Thai, Khmer). These mismatches lead to off-by-one token count differences that hurt KV cache alignment and cause small but measurable throughput regressions and profile publish drift. This ticket implements a resolver pass and a compatibility sweep across the onboarding pipeline to normalize delimiter handling, add language-aware smoke checks, and gate performance profile publishing on a tokenizer-template validation step.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic resolver pass exists that normalizes role delimiter tokens across supported tokenizers without changing model-visible tokenization for canonical English templates
Onboarding pipeline runs an automated template-tokenizer compatibility check and marks bundles as 'template-compatible' or 'needs-fix'
Publishing a performance profile is blocked for bundles that fail compatibility checks; a manual override requires a documented risk waiver
KV cache alignment telemetry shows no more than 0.5% additional misaligned prefixes for newly onboarded models in the 2-week rolling window after rollout
Integration tests added for combinations: ASCII roles, Unicode combining sequences, ZWJ, ZWNJ, and space-free languages (Thai/Khmer)
reproduction_steps: 1) Take model bundle with tokenizer that emits separate combining-mark tokens (internal test models simulating e.g., Indic eng).

2) Use current onboarding template for chat messages with system
and assistant role markers that include trailing ZWJ or soft-hyphen artifacts from upstream templates.
3) Run the onboarding pipeline profile publish step and observe token counts produced by tokenizer vs. those assumed by template serializer.
4) Note mismatches in published profile metrics (per-token latency skew) and failing smoke check logs under logs/onboard-<bundle>/tokenizer-check.json
implementation_notes: Add TokenFragmentResolver module in onboarding service: input = (tokenizer, template), output = normalized template tokens + mapping of original->resolved token indices

Resolver should implement language-aware heuristics: collapse zero-width spaces, treat ZWJ+combining sequences as single token anchors for role delimiters, and optionally coalesce soft-hyphens in delimiter vicinity
Do not change tokenizer library internals; implement resolver as a post-tokenize alignment layer to preserve model behavior
Expose resolver telemetry: per-bundle mismatch_count, correction_actions_taken, language_hint
Integrate resolver into the pre-publish gate: run resolver, run integration checks, if failure mark pipeline as 'template-mismatch' and emit prescriptive remediation hints
Add unit tests for resolver with fuzz corpus including Unicode edge cases collected from production logs (anonymized)
Coordinate with SDK teams to add a runtime flag to enable graceful fallback at inference time for pinned bundles that have unresolved template mismatches
Estimate refactor impact: onboarding service + CI pipelines + a small console UI flag to show 'template compatibility' status
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary, 3 days): Deploy resolver to onboarding-canary cluster, run against 100 recent bundles during ingest, monitor telemetry and false positives
Phase 2 (validation, 7 days): Run resolver in blocking mode in staging for all new bundles; create remediation tickets for failures; gather performance profile publish success rate
Phase 3 (gradual opt-in): Default gate blocking enabled for non-critical customers; allow manual override in Console with documented waiver
Phase 4 (full enforcement): After 2 weeks of stable metrics, enable blocking for all new onboarded bundles and require remediation before publish
comments: 2025-02-18 - Aisha Kapoor: Created ticket after triage. Noticed two customer bundles in staging where profile publish showed +1 token drift in role prefix for Vietnamese + Thai samples.

2025-02-21 - Liam Chen: Wrote initial TokenFragmentResolver prototype. Prototype collapsed sequences using a ZWJ-aware regex and passed 350/400 fuzz cases. Still failing on sequences with soft-hyphen followed by combining macron.

2025-02-25 - QA (Marta Ruiz): Added integration tests for ZWJ and combining sequences. Found a regression where resolver incorrectly coalesced legitimate trailing punctuation in Welsh templates. Added whitelist for punctuation clusters.

2025-03-01 - Liam Chen: Wire-up to publish gate implemented. Blocking flag defaults to false in staging. Telemetry emitted under onboarding.token_fragment_resolver.v1. Observed 0.9% false-positive corrections in canary run; investigating filter thresholds.

2025-03-04 - Aisha Kapoor: Decided with PM to require a remediation primer in Console for any 'template-mismatch' bundle explaining actions (edit template, adjust delimiter placement, request tokenizer tweaks). PM will own Console text and waiver UX (see PM-402).
